name: 3M 6800 Full Facepiece Reusable Respirator
summary: A medium reusable full facepiece with a clear lens and bayonet filter connections. The facepiece alone does not filter air; hazard selection, compatible approved components and a tight fit are essential.
description: The 6800 is the medium facepiece in 3M’s 6000 series. It is a component of a respiratory-protection system, not a ready-to-use universal emergency mask. Filters or cartridges must match the assessed hazard and approved assembly. This illustration intentionally shows empty connections: it does not establish included accessories or authenticate a seller. Occupational selection, training, fit testing and the supplied instructions take priority over a catalogue description.

cons: The facepiece alone does not filter air; filters or cartridges are necessary and not confirmed as included.

Plan inspection, cleaning, storage and cartridge-change procedures for a known workplace hazard.

confirmed.text: 3M Canada identifies 6800 as the medium bayonet full facepiece with a clear polycarbonate lens and four-point harness.
Use limitations and approved assemblies must be read in the manufacturer instructions; a facepiece without suitable filters is not ready to filter air.

unverifiedClaims: Current Canadian ASIN/model selection, seller, package, lot and delivered-unit labels remain unverified.
safetyNotes: Use only compatible filters or cartridges in the manufacturer-approved configuration selected for the actual hazard.
Required fit testing, training and a user seal check are essential; a seal check does not replace a fit test.
The respirator supplies no oxygen. Do not use in oxygen-deficient, unknown or immediately dangerous to life or health atmospheres.
It does not automatically protect against every gas, virus, chemical or nuclear hazard. The facepiece alone is not a complete protective system.
